layout_architecture.history_panel: Slide-over panel listing past validation batches, timestamp, total counts, deliverability score, and re-run/export options.

visual_enhancers.glow_effects: shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.15)] for valid cards, shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(239,68,68,0.15)] for error cards
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Animated progress bar, real-time pulse dots on active worker threads, instant toast feedback on copy/download

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or crisp 6px rounded edges with hover glow effects and micro transform scales (`active:scale-95`).
component_guidelines.inputs: Textarea with dark monospace styling (`bg-gray-950 text-emerald-400 font-mono text-xs p-4 border border-gray-800 focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-emerald-500`).
component_guidelines.toasts: Sonner library for crisp alerts on list copy, file downloads, and batch completion.

image_urls.description: Futuristic neon high-density data network cityscape

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the React frontend with a two-panel side-by-side workspace: Input list on the left with thread & filter controls, and two output boxes on the right (Valid/Deliverable vs Invalid/Bounce/Error).
Provide Copy to Clipboard and Download (.txt / .csv) functionality for both output boxes with Sonner toast feedback.
Include thread concurrency settings (1 to 20 threads) and live checking progress indicator with animated progress bar and throughput stats.
Add detailed per-email tag classification (e.g., Syntax Error, No MX Record, Disposable Domain, Role Account, Deliverable).
Include a Check History drawer/panel storing previous validation runs with timestamps and deliverability breakdown.
Strictly attach all `data-testid` attributes listed in `required_test_ids`.
Do NOT use HTML raw select or date pickers; use customized Shadcn primitives.
